implementation: native capture; one report group; D1 projections; separate summary; one inherited edge; stable-day timezone offset cache

environment.workload: mixed: four tracking types, three cadences, three reminder calendars
environment.execution: sequential; workspace checks finished before first sample; runtime sources unchanged through the series

metric: V8 inspector sampled active time, excluding idle/root/program frames; not Cloudflare billed CPU
limits: No 10 ms enforcement locally. Inspector/native binding and host scheduling can affect estimates.
Fresh means first measured Cron invocation in a separate Workerd; fixture setup happens before measurement. It does not prove a Cloudflare isolate cold start.
Only first and last calculation positions have three fresh samples; other positions have one.
Fifteen repeated cycles remain a small local distribution. Real D1, network, platform limits and future workload may differ.
Local fake transport sends no Telegram message. No deployment or remote mutation by this benchmark.
Dense mixed workload already has entries on the question date, so ordinary reminders may cancel. The separate empty-day uniform series verifies actual question/digest transport branches.
hour-question measures maintenance with a due rule; hour-queued-question also measures an already queued send on the following tick.
Two mixed repeated estimates exceeded 10 ms. They remain included in totals; no assertion that they are harmless host noise or that Cloudflare CPU is below the limit.

intermediateCandidate.description: native capture and one group, before D1 read projections
intermediateCandidate.warmSeries: Stopped intentionally after 10 minutes; incomplete and overlapped later editing/typechecks. Not acceptance evidence.

projectedCandidate.cause: localParts dominated both inheritance outliers; addressed with a derived stable-day timezone offset cache

commands: PLANNER_PROFILE_WORKLOAD=mixed PLANNER_PROFILE_GOALS=24 PLANNER_PROFILE_FIRST_SCENARIO=<stage> PLANNER_PROFILE_FIRST_ONLY=1 PLANNER_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT=<previous.snapshot.json> PLANNER_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_OUTPUT=<next.snapshot.json> pnpm reminders:profile
PLANNER_PROFILE_WORKLOAD=uniform PLANNER_PROFILE_GOALS=24 PLANNER_PROFILE_FIRST_SCENARIO=queued-question PLANNER_PROFILE_FIRST_ONLY=1 pnpm reminders:profile # three independent processes

ordinarySends.workload: uniform 24 daily time goals per owner, no entries; actual local transport branches instead of cancellation for existing records

acceptance.nextStep: Obtain explicit deployment and one additional real report authorization; correlate actual Cloudflare CPU for every persisted stage. Native fetch/tracing samples cannot establish the reason for elapsed inspector spikes or exclude actual production CPU risk.
